name: HELM
description: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models, Stanford CRFM's open-source framework for reproducible, multi-metric evaluation. Scenarios wrap datasets in standard prompts, run-specs fix shots and decoding, and metrics cover accuracy plus efficiency, bias, toxicity and calibration; CRFM self-runs the framework to publish leaderboards such as HELM Capabilities (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, WildBench, Omni-MATH). Useful as an independent cross-lab baseline, though it entered maintenance mode in June 2026.
notes: Marked archived because HELM entered maintenance mode on 2026-06-01: no new features and no new evaluations added to leaderboards (docs/maintenance_mode.md). First release v0.1.0 on 2022-11-17. Benchmarks from src/helm/benchmark/scenarios (mmlu, mmlu_pro, gpqa with gpqa_diamond subset, ifeval, gsm, math, code_scenario humaneval, commonsense_scenario hellaswag, truthful_qa). arXiv 2211.09110 title verified: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models.
